summary: A live jungle firmware that slices a drum break into sixteen 8th notes and lets you play rolls, stretches and effects over it from the panel.
features: Held white keys trigger repeats, builds, echo, rolls and "STRETCH"
Black keys play single hits plus feedback, lo-fi and octave-down
Pattern variation, phrase-end fills and a freeze mode
Three built-in breaks and four slots for your own via a web page
Follows and sends MIDI clock over USB and Bluetooth; also follows TRS
Settings are not saved; starts at 160 BPM on each power-on
